title: Context mapping
activation: acting inside a system you did not build or do not hold in your head
inheriting a codebase, service, program, or vendor relationship; onboarding; integrating; resuming shifted ground
map the dependencies, owners, boundaries, and unknowns before changing anything
how the parts relate, what depends on what, who owns it
standDown: you already hold the map, know the system, just implement
a one-line fix whose neighbors do not matter, rename a variable
a plain question with no system to map
inputs: the system's own material: code, documents, ownership files, declared sources
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: an unknown that blocks safe action is raised as a question, never guessed
